staging.path: base image by digest (= FROM of the todo-15 GPU image hypertrain-gpu:local ae7f42fe80f3) + stage.tar (hypertrain src, experiments/gpu_phase_b, hashed requirements, shard) streamed over ssh and checked by sha256 + pip install --require-hashes
staging.why: the todo-15 image is 11.6 GB (11.3 GB base + 308 MB /opt/hypertrain venv); docker save/scp/load is impossible inside a Vast container (no docker daemon) and a registry push is forbidden; the base digest is what the GPU image builds FROM, so torch/CUDA bits are identical; same path proven on 3 hosts in todo 12
staging.provenance: worker records env.code_sha256 over the imported hypertrain sources and stage_tar_sha256 is journaled; image /opt/hypertrain/src differs from the tree only in src/hypertrain/challenge/store.py (not imported by the trainer)

setup_command: /venv/main/bin/python -c 'import sys,torch; sys.exit(torch.__version__ != "2.14.0+cu130" or torch.cuda.device_count() != 8)' && /venv/main/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r docker/phase-a/requirements.txt && (command -v iperf3 >/dev/null || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq iperf3) || true)
provenance: example: copy to live-config.json (unpublished) and fill in; select_hosts.py rewrites hosts/provenance
